articles.title: Justin Sun says Tron’s post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
articles.snippet: “We’re ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time,” Sun said in a post on X.

articles.title: AI Will Hit 40% of Jobs, IMF Warns. Young People Are First in Line
articles.snippet: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva says AI investment is holding global growth near 3%, with Asian chipmakers winning big, while warning of a 'slow-moving tsunami' for young workers.
